display: Krishna as the Vrindavan cowherd youth

visual_bible.age_and_face: A serene youthful face with calm almond-shaped eyes; clearly youth, never infant-like.
visual_bible.skin: Deep matte blue, rendered as opaque mineral pigment.
visual_bible.costume: Yellow dhoti and muted red-orange shawl.
visual_bible.forehead: Plain, smooth forehead with no mark.
visual_bible.crown: One simple low gold band with a single upright peacock feather; never a tall tiered crown.
visual_bible.anatomy: Ordinary youthful human proportions, one face, two attached arms and hands, two legs and feet.
visual_bible.style: Follow the series flat matte South Indian temple mural contract.
